intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is writing in the margin of a thick herbal. The crest on its cover belongs to the Royal Physician.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Page ninety. ‘For a burnt thumb, apply three leeches.’”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Three. On a thumb. I’ve written *cold water* and *leave the leeches out of this*.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A large man in velvet robes stops at her elbow. He looks at her pencil the way you’d look at a wasp.

intro.speaker: PHYSICIAN
intro.text: “Princess. That is *my* herbal. I have prescribed from that book for thirty years.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I know, Doctor Leeches. I’ve met the thumbs.”

options.labelText: “Cold water for a burn. How long do you keep it under?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Twenty minutes. Everyone stops at two and calls it twenty.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Dorrance sniffs. Then he takes out his own pencil and writes *twenty* beside her note.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “By next week, that’ll have been his idea.”

options.labelText: “He’s the Royal Physician, though. Maybe go a little easier on him?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Senna rubs out *leave the leeches out of this*. She writes it again, smaller.
